nodes.title: Prepare H3 Continuation
widgets_values: Continue the previous shot naturally, preserving motion, ambience and scene continuity.

This workflow generates the **future with FL2VA**, regardless of whether the source segment was FL2VA or Ref2VA. The protected joint-AV latent prefix carries continuity; packet references are intentionally ignored by the FL2VA continuation-conditioning branch.

H3 Sampling owns the acceleration adapter and records the actual LoRA hash. Turbo 4 uses the matching FL2V v1.1 768p or Ref2V recipe. Select Standard - 20 steps for stock sampling: no separate LoRA toggle is needed.

For creative LoRAs, apply them after Sampling and pass the complete ordered applied LoRA list to Pack.
nodes.title: Turbo 8-step / stock 20-step fallback
Continuation controls
widgets_values:
**Source family:** may be FL2VA or Ref2VA; source must be a direct H3 sampler-output latent.

**Future family:** this workflow is fixed to FL2VA. Use the Ref2VA continuation workflow when the unknown future should consume reference media.

**End frame:** optional AddGuide endpoint; it is independent from the protected prefix.

**Latent stitch:** keep video/audio handover equal on exact shared AV boundaries (39, 90, 141, ...). Mixed FL2VA/Ref2VA chains are stitchable only when each segment is a direct child of the previous latent revision.
